🌋 Godzilla Docs
  • Authentication
  • Getting Started
  • Installation
  • Quickstart

Quickstart

The fastest path from zero to a running pipeline.

Prerequisites

This guide assumes you've completed the Installation steps and have an API key from Authentication.

Create a pipeline

Bash

terminal bash 
curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"name":"my-first-pipeline","source_connector_id":"conn_demo_source","destination_connector_id":"conn_demo_dest"}'

Go

main.go go 
package main

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"github.com/godzilla-io/sdk-go"
)

func main() {
	client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))
	pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(context.Background(), &godzilla.CreatePipelineRequest{
		Name:                   "my-first-pipeline",
		SourceConnectorID:      "conn_demo_source",
		DestinationConnectorID: "conn_demo_dest",
	})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

Watch it run

Subscribe to pipeline.completed via Webhooks, or poll the Events endpoint to see events as they're processed.

That's it

For a fuller walkthrough with a real source and destination, go to Building your first pipeline in the Guides section.
